summary.name: Firebase
summary.one_liner: Firebase is Google's mobile and web app development platform for building Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity and web apps with managed backend infrastructure and AI features.
use_cases: Building AI-powered features into Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity or web apps
Hosting and scaling storage for a mobile or web app
Growing user engagement in an app
Shipping a game or app with managed cloud infrastructure
summary.what_it_does: Firebase is a development platform from Google for building mobile and web apps and games. The page says it provides managed infrastructure powered by Google Cloud so developers can avoid running their own backend. It lets apps use Gemini models client-side through Firebase AI Logic for Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity and web. Listed services include hosting, scalable storage and event triggers, and the page says Firebase products can be combined for onboarding, engagement and added functionality. A billing account comes with $300 in credit toward services.
notable: Client-side Gemini access via Firebase AI Logic
$300 credit on creating a Billing Account
Managed backend powered by Google Cloud
Used by companies such as NPR, Halfbrick, Duolingo and Venmo (per page)
caveats: Credit requires creating a Billing Account; ongoing costs beyond the credit are not detailed on the page
Page is mostly marketing; specific feature limits and pricing tiers are not listed
